events.title: Social Games at Broadbeach
events.description: Join a relaxed session of board games and card games at the library, fostering community connection and lighthearted social interaction. This is a great chance to meet new people in a casual setting.

events.title: LEGO® Drop-In at Nerang
events.description: Unleash your creativity at this free drop-in LEGO® session at Nerang Library, suitable for all ages to build, create, and connect with fellow LEGO enthusiasts.

events.title: Chess Get Together at Elanora
events.description: Join fellow chess enthusiasts for a casual game or two at Elanora Library, offering a chance to practice your strategy and engage in friendly competition. All skill levels are welcome to participate.

events.title: Chess Get Together at Southport
events.description: Connect with other chess players at Southport Library for an afternoon of strategic thinking and social games. This informal gathering is open to anyone interested in playing chess.

events.title: Writers Masterclass: Creating queer stories with Cale Dietrich
events.source: Queensland Writers Centre / City of Gold Coast Libraries
events.description: Award-winning author Cale Dietrich leads a masterclass on crafting compelling queer narratives, offering insights and practical advice for aspiring and experienced writers. This workshop is an excellent opportunity to refine your storytelling skills and explore diverse perspectives.

events.title: Trivia Tuesdays
events.location: Sports Bar, The Star Gold Coast
events.description: Test your general knowledge at The Star's weekly Trivia Tuesdays, offering a fun and social evening with friends or new acquaintances. Prizes are often up for grabs for the sharpest minds.

events.title: Jazz & Gin Thursdays
events.location: Garden Kitchen & Bar, The Star Gold Coast
events.description: Enjoy an evening of live jazz music in the stylish setting of Garden Kitchen & Bar, perfect for a sophisticated and relaxed social experience. Immerse yourself in the smooth sounds and vibrant atmosphere.

events.title: Line Dancing on the Lawn
events.location: The Lawn, The Star Gold Coast
events.description: Learn classic line dancing steps or practice your moves on The Star's spacious lawn, an energetic and social outdoor activity for all ages and skill levels.

events.title: Line Dancing on the Lawn
events.location: The Lawn, The Star Gold Coast
events.description: Participate in a lively line dancing session on The Star's outdoor lawn, offering a fun and active way to socialise and get moving. Open to beginners and experienced dancers alike.

events.title: Comedy Club Sundays
events.location: Atrium Bar, The Star Gold Coast
events.description: Enjoy a night of laughs with stand-up comedians at the Atrium Bar's weekly Comedy Club, featuring local and visiting talent in an intimate setting. It's a great way to unwind and share some humour.
